mapper.sql: s.schedule_id, s.user_id, s.room_id, s.title, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.memo, s.is_secret, s.show_in_compare, s.status, s.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, s.start_time, s.end_time FROM users u JOIN schedule s ON s.status <> 'CANCELED' AND s.show_in_compare = 1 AND s.start_time < #{to} AND s.end_time > #{from} AND ( s.user_id = u.user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schedule_member m WHERE m.schedule_id = s.schedule_id AND m.user_id = u.user_id AND m.status = 'ACCEPTED') ) WHERE u.user_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.start_time

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id, u.nickname FROM users u JOIN schedule s ON s.status <> 'CANCELED' AND s.show_in_compare = 1 AND s.start_time < #{end} AND s.end_time > #{start} AND ( s.user_id = u.user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schedule_member m WHERE m.schedule_id = s.schedule_id AND m.user_id = u.user_id AND m.status = 'ACCEPTED') ) WHERE u.user_id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule (user_id, room_id, title, start_time, end_time, memo, is_secret, show_in_compare, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roomId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{title}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isSecret}, #{showInCompare}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule SET title = #{title}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, memo = #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, is_secret = #{isSecret}, show_in_compare = #{showInCompare} WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}

UPDATE schedule SET status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schedule_member m WHERE m.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND m.status <> 'ACCEPTED')
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM schedule_member WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}

SELECT s.schedule_id FROM schedule_member m JOIN schedule s ON s.schedule_id = m.schedule_id WHERE s.room_id = #{roomId} AND s.status = 'PENDING' AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'PENDING'

SELECT s.schedule_id, s.title, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.memo, s.room_id, r.room_title, s.user_id AS owner_id, u.nickname AS owner_nickname FROM schedule_member m JOIN schedule s ON s.schedule_id = m.schedule_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = s.room_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'PENDING' AND s.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY s.start_time
